answer: Each epoch the network rotates a cipher key, and an identity keeps earning only by presenting a trellis of signed work receipts from at least five distinct counterparties served that epoch, each chained to the last. Under every identity sits a knoll of locked stake: if any receipt is proven fake, the knoll is slashed and the trellis collapses, wiping its earnings. A sybil farm must win five real, different customers per clone each epoch - its own nodes cannot vouch for each other, since receipts from the same funding cluster count as one. Cloning multiplies the work, never the reward.
